enhancements.name: Bonus Card
enhancements.flavor: A card that gives a little something extra.

enhancements.name: Wild Card
enhancements.flavor: The trickster of the deck — it fits anywhere.

enhancements.name: Glass Card
enhancements.description: ×2 Mult when scored. 1 in 4 chance to shatter after scoring.
enhancements.flavor: Beautiful and fragile — worth the risk.

enhancements.name: Steel Card
enhancements.flavor: Its worth grows simply by being held.

enhancements.name: Stone Card
enhancements.description: +50 Coins when scored. No rank or suit.

enhancements.name: Gold Card
enhancements.description: Earn $3 when held in hand at end of round
enhancements.flavor: The gold card pays you just for keeping it close.

enhancements.name: Lucky Card
enhancements.description: 1 in 5 chance of +20 Mult. 1 in 15 chance of +$20.
enhancements.flavor: Fortune favours the bold — or perhaps just the foolish.

enhancements.name: Foil Card
enhancements.flavor: Gleaming foil pressed into the card's surface — every coin brighter.

enhancements.name: Holo Card
enhancements.flavor: The shifting hologram catches the eye and multiplies the power.

enhancements.name: Ancient Card
enhancements.description: Retriggered by the suit of the last played book
enhancements.flavor: This card remembers every hand that came before it.

enhancements.name: Runic Card
enhancements.description: +15 Coins when scored. 1 in 4 chance for +2 Mult.
enhancements.flavor: Scratched with druidic marks — old power bleeds through.

enhancements.name: Fire Card
enhancements.flavor: The fire element consumes doubt and multiplies conviction.

enhancements.name: Water Card
enhancements.description: +20 Coins when scored. If 2+ others of the same suit were played, earn $1.
enhancements.flavor: Water flows where it will — and carries coins with it.

enhancements.name: Earth Card
enhancements.flavor: Rooted deep — the earth gives without asking.

enhancements.name: Bone Card
enhancements.description: This card's rank coin value is doubled
enhancements.flavor: Stripped to the bone — what remains is pure and twice as weighty.

seals.name: Gold Seal
seals.description: Earn $3 when this card is played
seals.flavor: A golden impression — every play pays out.

seals.name: Red Seal
seals.flavor: Red wax seals a secret — play it twice to reveal both.

seals.name: Blue Seal
seals.flavor: Calm as deep water — its power held close.

seals.name: Purple Seal
seals.description: Creates a Totem card when discarded
seals.flavor: Cast it away — and something sacred rises in its place.
